definition_quote.value: the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the vision system, eyes, and adjacent and associated structures, including the use or prescription of lenses, prisms, vision therapy, vision rehabilitation, and prescription or nonprescription drugs including schedule II controlled narcotic substances limited to hydrocodone combination drugs and schedule III, IV, and V controlled narcotic substances for ocular disease, so long as an optometrist is practicing within the scope of his or her education as is commonly taught in accredited schools and colleges of optometry and is practicing in accordance with applicable federal and Colorado law and board rules
definition_quote.quote: the "practice of optometry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the vision system, eyes, and adjacent and associated structures, including the use or prescription of lenses, prisms, vision therapy, vision rehabilitation, and prescription or nonprescription drugs including schedule II controlled narcotic substances limited to hydrocodone combination drugs and schedule III, IV, and V controlled narcotic substances for ocular disease, so long as an optometrist is practicing within the scope of his or her education as is commonly taught in accredited schools and colleges of optometry and is practicing in accordance with applicable federal and Colorado law and board rules

methods_authorized.quote: the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, or treatment of diseases, disorders, or conditions of the vision system, eyes, and adjacent and associated structures, including the use or prescription of lenses, prisms, vision therapy, vision rehabilitation, and prescription or nonprescription drugs

drug_authority.value: Prescription or nonprescription drugs including schedule II controlled narcotic substances limited to hydrocodone combination drugs and schedule III, IV, and V controlled narcotic substances for ocular disease; topical and oral antiglaucoma drugs; epinephrine auto-injector for anaphylaxis; local anesthetics; and other drugs as specified in scope of practice
drug_authority.quote: prescription or nonprescription drugs including schedule II controlled narcotic substances limited to hydrocodone combination drugs and schedule III, IV, and V controlled narcotic substances for ocular disease

surgery_prohibited.quote: The "practice of optometry" does not include: Surgery of or injections into the globe, orbit, eyelids, or ocular adnexa. "Surgery" means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or laser means.

surgery_definition.value: any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or laser means
surgery_definition.quote: "Surgery" means any procedure in which human tissue is cut, altered, or otherwise infiltrated by mechanical or laser means.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: The following are part of the practice of optometry: The removal of superficial foreign bodies from the human eye or its appendages

laser_procedures_authorized.quote: Laser capsulotomy, laser peripheral iridotomy, and laser trabeculoplasty.

injections for the treatment of conditions or diseases of the eye or eyelid, excluding intraocular injections penetrating the globe
use of a local anesthetic in conjunction with the primary treatment of an eyelid lesion

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: The treatment of glaucoma with all topical and oral antiglaucoma drugs.

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: The use of injectable drugs, except for the use of an epinephrine auto-injector to counteract anaphylactic reaction.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: the use or prescription of lenses, prisms, vision therapy, vision rehabilitation, and prescription or nonprescription drugs

value: Schedule II narcotics prohibited except hydrocodone combination drugs
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: The use of schedule I or II narcotics, except for hydrocodone combination drugs

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: A prescriber shall not prescribe more than a seven-day supply of an opioid to a patient who has not obtained an opioid prescription from that prescriber within the last twelve months

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: The treatment of glaucoma with all topical and oral antiglaucoma drugs.

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: A therapeutic optometrist is an optometrist licensed pursuant to this article 275 who meets the requirements of section 12-275-113 (2) and (4). A licensed optometrist shall not use prescription or nonprescription drugs for treatment of eye disease or disorder or for any therapeutic purpose unless he or she is a therapeutic optometrist.

tiered_license_types.quote: A therapeutic optometrist is an optometrist licensed pursuant to this article 275 who meets the requirements of section 12-275-113 (2) and (4).

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: Successful completion, by attendance and examination, of at least sixty classroom hours of study in ocular pharmacology, clinical pharmacology, therapeutics, and anterior segment disease

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: successful completion by attendance and examination of at least sixty hours of approved supervised clinical training in the examination, diagnosis, and treatment of conditions of the human eye and its appendages

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: The optometrist shall release to the patient, upon written request, a valid, written contact lens prescription at the time the optometrist would otherwise replace a contact lens without any additional preliminary examination or fitting.
